'''January 2001 Minneapolis tournament (13 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 13 January 2001. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Justin Alfs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1624">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-13d1624/ moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-13], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-13d1624/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
